hypotheses.I0_path_integral_reconstructs_finite_eff: The nine integrated analytic paths reconstruct every aggregate finite answer-logit effect with energy fidelity at least 0.9999 at both edit scales.
hypotheses.I1_bilinear_direct_paths_dominate_qk_dir: In both mixed seeds and at both scales, the combined ML/MR direct-path norm is larger than the Q direct-path norm.
hypotheses.I2_qk_path_is_finitely_material: In both mixed seeds and at both scales, integrated Q-path norm is at least 5 percent of finite-effect norm.
hypotheses.I3_local_value_path_is_small: In every run and scale, integrated V-path norm is at most 2 percent of finite-effect norm.
hypotheses.I4_bilinear_attention_interactions_are_m: In both mixed seeds and at both scales, the four integrated bilinear-by-attention interaction paths have combined norm at least 5 percent of finite-effect norm.
hypotheses.I5_attribution_is_stable_across_scale: Within every run, each grouped signed projection changes by at most 0.15 between 5%- and 50%-norm edits.
